scope: Secret API keys on the real server (Hostinger, Ubuntu 26.04) after the signed v0.4.0 was installed through the release channel, through the public address behind Cloudflare, against the one existing environment (no application data). A temporary secret key and a temporary publishable key were issued in the server's key store by a one-off script, used with supabase-js and plain fetch, and revoked; a temporary table with row level security was created and dropped. Not a load test; Realtime and Edge Functions with a secret key were covered by unit tests only.

checks.check: the secret key reads a row that row level security hides (no policy, RLS on)
the publishable key sees no row of that table
the secret key creates a user through auth.admin.createUser and deletes it
the publishable key is refused by auth.admin.listUsers
the secret key lists Storage buckets
the secret key with a Chrome user agent is refused
the secret key with an Origin header is refused
the revoked secret key is refused
temporary keys revoked and the temporary table dropped
